archetypes.name: dyn-harness-shard-inventory
archetypes.rationale: Shard inventory must accept *-bash-harness leaves and reject aggregates or pytest recipes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect scripts/test-harness-shards-coverage.sh extract_individual_targets and non-leaf classification against the Makefile shard lists. Confirm write-final-report-bash-harness and the three new *-bash-harness leaves are inventory members, public aggregates are excluded, and --self-test covers missing Bash leaves plus aggregate/pytest-in-shard rejection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
